comment: Real-world Idris 2 code tokenised by test/grammar/corpus.test.ts. scripts/fetch-corpus.mjs fetches each entry at its pinned commit into .corpus/<name> (git-ignored); nothing here is copied into the repository. `paths` are the top-level directories checked out and tokenised. `endsInsideBlockComment` lists files whose last lines are inside a block comment that is never closed, which the lexer accepts (the `eof` alternatives of blockComment and toEndComment, src/Parser/Lexer/Common.idr 40 and 65); each was confirmed by reading it.
